The argument covers every 0<a<b, including limiting close pairs without claiming a=b.

value.rationale: The full Zak zero divisor determines the complete obstruction geometry for a natural continuous two-parameter family of rational Gabor windows, without restricting the invariant pole ratio. Exactly three nondegenerate zeros with stable signed indices rules out hidden additional zeros, an issue significant in time-frequency frame analysis (cf. Faulhuber). It is a global parametric classification and not an isolated numeric/root calculation; it does not purport to solve the full Gabor frame set.
